overview: Clearing up the tiring-house after the sharers' vote, you, John Heminges, and Augustine Phillips went over the three dates (26 July, 25 August, 17 July) with no road sum written, Kemp's lone dissent, and August's fit for the pages before walking to the Jackdaw for Richard's birthday supper.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Acknowledged Kemp's point on hired men's wages and carried the pearwood glass for Richard.

parties.name: John Heminges
parties.context: Recapped the three dates with no sum under them and locked the sheet away before the Jackdaw.

parties.name: Augustine Phillips
parties.context: Noted Kemp left still muttering about Kent and said he saved his throat for tonight's singing.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: Walked out still standing against the closure and talking of Kent.

parties.name: Thomas Pope
parties.context: Pressed William to own aloud that August suits the pages.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Twenty-seventh birthday supper waiting at the Jackdaw.
